verdict.pick: Dr. Elsey's Cat Attract Multi-Cat Strength
verdict.line: Picture a busy household with several cats: this litter keeps the box clean with minimal dust and strong clumping, making scooping quick. It also controls odor effectively, so the living area stays fresh. The main catch is that it can be pricier than some alternatives.
